purpose: Rung P4b (heredity carrier channels, G1b), fourth case: judge Cells' own physics (resolved_pump_tissue@3 with network channel populations) on the rung-1 mammal default world, no world change: NaV1.2 (P = 1.875e-15 / 7.5e-9 = 2.5e-7 m/s, the E07-v1 anchor) and K leak (6e-18 / 7.5e-9 = 8e-10 m/s, as P4) active from INIT. INIT comes to rest in the NaV1.2 window state near -21.2 mV, the heredity D-state voltage (-21.5 mV), which the first three P4b cases left between their NaV1.2 ranges; SIM continues there (Vm nearly flat). Against the plain-BETSE case parity-p4b-channels-20261110-01/derive-03/betse-reference/p4b-nav-kleak-dense (general network with only these channels, no biomolecules). Tolerances by the pinned method (3 x the sum of measured terms; every cell-ion field term propagated through the reference emulator).

tolerance_derivation.method: 3 x (sum of measured difference terms), rounded up to one significant figure; per ion for concentrations (a zero sum gets the floor 1e-12)

step_order_rule.outcome: dt1-dt100 step terms; model-difference terms at dt/100
step_order_rule.rule: BETSE's step term is (10/9) |x(dt) - x(dt/10)| (emulator, SIM chained) if the observed order on this case (dt, dt/10, dt/100) is within 0.9-1.1 for Vm and every cell ion but P in INIT and SIM; otherwise |x(dt) - x(dt/100)| for the step term, and the compact-ECM-face and gate-once terms at dt/100 instead of dt/10 (the P4b rule of 10 November, checked on this case itself; validation/betse/step_order.py). A failed check counts as the fallback.

tolerance_derivation.field_terms: cell-ion, Vm and ECM field terms propagated through the BETSE-order emulator (validation/betse/field_propagation.py --runner network; boltzmann, vpatch and both on the (1 ms, 0.1 ms) and (0.5 ms, 0.05 ms) blind layouts; max over the six pairs). The X_ext per-volt heuristic is not used. The ECM Boltzmann response of Cells' own exterior field (field_layouts) stays as in P4.

observable_mapping: BETSE vm in this world is cell charge / (cm * sum mem_sa), uniform within a cell (Phi_b = 0; v_env not subtracted; sim.py:2029). Cells vm_ave = Q_cell / sum C_patch with C_patch = cm * mem_sa, broadcast to membranes for vm. Patch voltages and exterior potentials are diag_* arrays, reported only. Boundary-ring ECM sites are excluded: BETSE resets them each step, the resolved model holds them as reservoirs.
notes: Reported only: venv_time (BETSE's screened, smoothed estimate has no Cells counterpart) and Cells diag_* arrays.
Gate open fractions are not in the comparison layout and are not judged.
Leave-one-out plain-BETSE cases: parity-p4b-channels-20261110-01/derive-03/betse-reference/p4b-nav-kleak-no-nav1p2-dense (K leak only) and p4b-nav-kleak-no-kleak-dense (NaV1.2 only).

Built with validation/betse/network_cases.py, step_order.py, parity_recipes.py and parity_protocols.py (snapshot 7829d34). The emulator terms use emulator_p4b_network_dense.json (roundoff tooling protocol; its betse_cases list names the first two P4b cases only).

cells_run.optional_repeat: gpu (L4): reported only, as layout-differences against the judged CPU run; not a verdict
cells_run.note: @3 IMEX ARS(2,2,2) with exponential stage gates (exponential_mean_rate_linear_target_gates@1); field solver @3 as P4. Judged runs on CPU; Cells-only terms from blind CPU runs at (1 ms, 0.1 ms) and (0.5 ms, 0.05 ms) INIT/SIM steps
cells_run.mapping: network_world_adapter.py run-resolved (NETWORK_RESOLVED): one population per membrane patch and network channel, Nav1p2 -> nav1p2_m3h_regularized@1 (Na), KLeak -> kleak_always_open@1 (K); max_permeability = max Dm / tm, abundance 1, relative permeability 1; availability 1; gates (m_inf, h_inf)(0 V) in INIT and (m_inf, h_inf)(Cells' INIT-end patch Vm) at the SIM handoff (BETSE re-reads the network at SIM start)

discrimination_ratio.definition: the option's own effect (plain BETSE with the channel against the same case without it; max over samples and phase end, interior ECM) divided by this protocol's tolerance, per phase and quantity (ion); ions at the 1e-12 floor (immobile P) are left out

non_discriminating_rule: Quantities listed here (ratio <= 1; per channel under discrimination_by_channel) are still judged, but that channel's effect does not exceed their tolerance, so no claim about that channel may rest on them.
status: PROPOSED, not registered: numbers from emulator-only budgets, emulator field propagation, plain BETSE vs plain BETSE and blind Cells-only runs; no Cells-vs-BETSE or Cells-vs-emulator difference has been computed for this case. To be fixed and committed by the lead before any judged run.

gate_lag.definition: per phase and active gated channel: gate and open-fraction ranges over every update and membrane, the largest |gate - gate_inf(Vm)| and the largest |P - P_inf| / max P_inf (network_world_adapter.gate_lag); a small lag means that phase tests the steady law, not the time constants

limits: BETSE's own step error is measured through the BETSE-order emulator (which reproduces plain BETSE to roundoff on this case: emulator/p4b-nav-kleak-dense-check-comparison), not by a fine-INIT BETSE twin (lead, 10 November). In P4 (parity-rung2-4-20261109-01/emulator-01) plain BETSE's dense-vs-fine step term was 0.980-0.999 of the emulator's dt-vs-dt/100 term for Vm, 0.92-1.04 for cell Na, K, Cl and M and 0.73-0.99 for cell Ca; the largest excess, 4.3% (cell Na, INIT, p4-kv1p5-kleak), is the recorded bound on the unmeasured part: at most 4.3% of the step term, so under 10% of the measured sum.

Covered voltage range (BETSE Vm over samples and membranes): NaV1.2 and K leak INIT -21.2 to 0.0 mV (from 0 V), SIM -21.2 to -21.2 mV. The judged claim is agreement over this range, which contains the heredity D-state voltage (-21.5 mV); law-level agreement over -120...+60 mV is the separate formulation check (parity-p4b-channels-20261110-01/formulation-01). NaV1.2's lower window region (-60...-35 mV) and the unstable point (-39 mV) stay unexercised.

One seeded geometry; BETSE's 5 s INIT at 10 ms and 35 ms SIM at 0.1 ms. Gates restart at steady state at SIM start, so time constants enter only through gate lag while Vm drifts (gate_lag). Here SIM is flat (NaV1.2 open-fraction lag 1.3e-6 relative): SIM tests the steady m^3 h window law near -21.2 mV, not the time constants. INIT lags (NaV1.2 open fraction 9.4%) include BETSE's one-step offset at 10 ms, so no kinetics claim rests on INIT.
SIM ratios are the INIT differences carried into SIM (Vm moves little there); no channel is switched on at SIM start in this case.
Channel populations on every membrane with 'apply to: all'; no activators, inhibitors, modulators or events.

This case's own step-order check fired (SIM Vm observed order 0.899, below 0.9; every other checked quantity 1.02-1.09), so by the rule its step term is |x(dt) - x(dt/100)| and its compact-ECM-face and gate-once terms are measured at dt/100 (not dt/10).
